note: Every gamerule of Java Edition 1.21.1 with its vanilla default. `servertool.py check-gamerules` reads all of them back over RCON and expects these values, with the active lines of gamerules-1.21.1.mcfunction (and a control) applied on top, so that 'everything else stays at the vanilla default' is checked, not assumed. NAMES and TYPES are checked: they are the 51 children of the `gamerule` command in misode/mcmeta 1.21.1-summary (commit 7cffbcdad5fa36f22acef6bd4b869ecad4ca3fd9, commands/data.json), with parser brigadier:bool or brigadier:integer. The pinned language.json also has gamerule.entitiesWithPassengersCanUsePortals, which is not in that command tree, so it is not listed. DEFAULT VALUES were written from memory on 2026-10-16 and VERIFIED on 2026-10-19 on the owner's PC: check-gamerules on a fresh 1.21.1 world (Fabric 0.19.5, the pins in mods-1.21.1.json) read all 51 rules and the difficulty back with 52 checks and no difference. If a later check shows a DIFF on a rule that is not frozen, the world was changed.
defaults_source: verified on a fresh 1.21.1 world, owner's PC, 2026-10-19 (check-gamerules: 52 checks PASS)

bridge_depends_on.showDeathMessages: false empties the death message, so PROTOCOL.md `death` events lose death_key and killer (the notebook's kill counters)
bridge_depends_on.doImmediateRespawn: true skips the death screen, bypassing the Node host's respawn_delay_ticks
bridge_depends_on.keepInventory: frozen false (DESIGN.md 10.1); true only in the keepInventory control
bridge_depends_on.doDaylightCycle: the simulator's clock advances one tick per tick (DESIGN.md 4.2)
bridge_depends_on.doMobSpawning: spawn rates are measured under the frozen config (DESIGN.md 11.2)
bridge_depends_on.randomTickSpeed: crop and sapling growth, leaf decay
bridge_depends_on.mobGriefing: creepers break blocks, endermen take blocks
